says: In next/, the Project object's public exit RPC (brain.ts exit, ProjectClient.exit in libfabrika cloudflare/platform.ts:163) has no caller in product code and writes any decoded exit reason, normal included, for any pid, while OTP ignores a normal exit signal from another process and the Runner's lifecycle read relies on only a process's own exit Cmd writing normal.
proof: rg -n '\bp\.exit\(|project\.exit\(|stub\.exit\(' next/packages next/apps --glob '!*test*' prints only brain.ts:126 (the method itself), cloudflare/runtime.ts:1536 (its implementation) and platform.ts:165 (the stub wrapper); the Runner's own exits go through processExit. cloudflare/runtime.ts:1530-1538 decodes the reason with decodeExitReason, which accepts normal.
cost: A future caller could end another process with normal mid-step, which the Runner's per-step lifecycle read (plan t753-l16-full-depth) would see only at the next step; unused surface to keep in step with the process table's rules.
